verdicts.note: The paper contrasts promising mechanical properties with poor oxidation resistance, but does not establish a direct trade-off between retaining the B2 matrix and forming complex oxides.

B2 ordering is associated with high strength and complex oxides with poor oxidation, but the paper does not show that these are opposing alternatives or that improving one necessarily worsens the other.
The B2 matrix is the initial alloy phase, whereas TiNb2O7 and Nb2Zr6O17 are oxidation products; the paper does not present their phase balance as a design lever.
